threshold_selection: maximum validation F1 per label, recall then closeness to .5 as tie-breakers
split_strategy: Exact 70/15/15 row allocation with balanced languages and randomly sampled label combinations. Source-family isolation and authored co-labels cause prevalence differences; this is not perfect iterative multi-label stratification.
limitations: Synthetic component-composed messages; source phrasing and correlations can differ substantially from real conversations.
